spell.arcane_addon.arcane_pulse.guide: Release a shockwave of raw arcane energy, damaging all enemies around you.
spell.arcane_addon.summon_greatsword.gui: Materialize a colossal black greatsword in your empty hand. It vanishes when you switch away from it.
ui.arcane_addon.empty_hand_required: Your hand must be empty to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Black Grimoire.
